rationale: No Tool Shed wrapper for cowpy. Queries 'cowpy', 'cowsay', 'cow say' returned no cow-art generator (the only 'cow say' hit was iuc codeml, an unrelated PAML tool). cowpy is an nf-core local module for a novelty command; falls through to author-galaxy-tool-wrapper.

warnings.message: Tool Shed index is stale by design; absence is soft evidence.
The step has no inputs and a fixed command, so a small user-defined tool is trivial to author; authoring was chosen.
